## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · seat `domain:ui#1` · 2026-10-26T08:20Z

Head `f96a85198f53` (read from the PR object).

- **Shape.** Draft on `main`; `Fixes #25890`; `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`; changeset `.changeset/25890-pending-changes-generated-group.md` in the root `.changeset/` (patch, app-shell + i18n).
- **Checks pinned to the head.** 61 named check runs, latest per name: 54 success, 7 skipped, 0 failing, 0 pending. `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, Test UI 16/16, Type Check UI all success.
- **Governed surface.** `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 25984`: 0 of 15 paths governed.
- **Changeset against the diff.** A field added or removed whose every definition carries `system: true` moves to the collapsed `generated` group; a system field CHANGED between bodies stays an author row; `nameField` is generated only when `provisionPrimary(body without the pointer, { synthesize: false })` derives the same name, so the derivation is the registry's own and not restated; a new item's keys are headed "Includes:"; the hidden injected columns stay dropped by the existing `isStudioHiddenSystemField` rule. Each sentence matches the code.
- **Deviations accepted.** (1) `label` / `name` / `sharingModel` stay under "Includes:" for a new object: they are the author's keys of a new item, and moving them would rewrite seven existing pins. The seat agrees with the dev's recommendation; no follow-up card. (2) The objectui#13125 pin's `owner_id` / `created_at` controls now assert "not dropped, in the generated group", which is the card's intent, not a widened rule. (3) Ten-pack i18n rows, required by the parity test. (4) `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` hash re-recorded, required by `check-sdui-manifest`.

⚠️ Merge order: #25978 (queued) also appends to the ten locale packs and moves the same manifest-record line. If this PR conflicts after it lands, the card thread merges `origin/main` and regenerates the record.

Landing: ready + auto-merge through the relay.
